recipes.name: Roasted Garlic & Red Pepper Hummus
instructions: Line a baking tray and preheat the oven to 450°F (250°C)*.
Add the bell peppers and garlic to the tray. Toss with oil, and bake for 25 minutes, or until the bell peppers are lightly charred. Flip once halfway.
Remove any charred skin and peel off the bell pepper and garlic. Transfer to a food processor and add all the remaining ingredients. Blend until smooth.
For a creamier consistency, consider adding more olive oil, tahini, or lemon juice to taste. Plate, garnish, and serve!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection).
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 5 days.
